text: Henry Fielding's Tom Jones was the subject of an arrêt of the Council of State suppressing its French translation in France. The Monthly Review reported in March 1750 that newspapers described the suppression as being on grounds of immorality.
meta_description: Tom Jones by Henry Fielding: its French translation was suppressed by an order of the Council of State; reported in March 1750 as on grounds of immorality.
changes: Author leads; suppression and March 1750 report kept with hedge.
